about: Cancel a VAT registration when the business closes, is sold or falls below the thresholds.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. VAT deregistration. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to any person registered for VAT
Apply from the same EmaraTax account used to register
Where deregistration is mandatory, apply within 30 business days of the obligation arising
documents: Depends on the reason, for example licence cancellation certificate, sale contract, amended licence or signed declarations
Completed financial turnover template (taxable supplies and expenses)
PDF, Excel, Docs, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB per file
timing: Final VAT return and payment due within 28 days of the effective date
channels: EmaraTax platform, sign in with UAE PASS
